lines.en: Guess what? Our roommate finally admitted that he had lied about the rent for three months.
lines.pt: Adivinha? Nosso colega de casa finalmente admitiu que tinha mentido sobre o aluguel por três meses.

lines.en: Really? Last week he denied that he had taken the money, and he claimed that he had paid everything.
lines.pt: Sério? Semana passada ele negou que tinha pegado o dinheiro, e alegou que tinha pagado tudo.

lines.en: Yes, and yesterday he confessed that he had spent it on a new laptop. I was really shocked.
lines.pt: Sim, e ontem ele confessou que tinha gastado num notebook novo. Fiquei muito chocada.

lines.en: Did he explain why? He told me that he had been afraid to tell us, because he had lost his job in March.
lines.pt: Ele explicou por quê? Me disse que tinha medo de nos contar, porque tinha perdido o emprego em março.

lines.en: He said that he had hoped to find another job before we noticed. He promised that he would pay us back.
lines.pt: Ele disse que tinha esperado achar outro emprego antes de a gente perceber. Prometeu que nos pagaria de volta.

lines.en: Honestly, I understood. But he insisted that he had never meant to hurt us, and that made me doubt him.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, entendi. Mas ele insistiu que nunca quis nos magoar, e isso me fez duvidar dele.

lines.en: Same here. He admitted that he had made a terrible mistake, and he apologised for not telling us the truth.
lines.pt: Eu também. Ele admitiu que tinha cometido um erro terrível e pediu desculpas por não ter dito a verdade.

lines.en: Well, our landlord warned us that he had already sent a reminder, so we were in real trouble.
lines.pt: Bem, o proprietário nos avisou que já tinha enviado um lembrete, então estávamos numa enrascada.

lines.en: True. The landlord claimed that we had ignored two emails, but we had not even received them.
lines.pt: Verdade. O proprietário alegou que tínhamos ignorado dois e-mails, mas nem os tínhamos recebido.

lines.en: Then we should ask him to check the address. I’ll write that we had never got any notice.
lines.pt: Então devemos pedir que ele confira o endereço. Vou escrever que nunca recebemos aviso algum.

lines.en: Good plan. And tell him that our roommate had admitted everything, so there is a clear solution.
lines.pt: Bom plano. E diga a ele que nosso colega admitiu tudo, então há uma solução clara.

facts.label: Verbos de relato
facts.sub: Relate o que alguém admitiu, negou ou confessou: He admitted that he had lied. Sem me depois de admit. O tempo recua um passo.

facts.label: Admitiu que
facts.sub: Use admitted that + had + particípio para relatar uma confissão sobre algo anterior: He admitted that he had lied. Pode usar também admitted to me that.

facts.label: Negou que
facts.sub: Para relatar uma negação: She denied that she had taken it. Após denied use that + oração, ou -ing. Não use to + verbo nem me.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: He admitted that he had lied is a report in the past.
“Denied that” can be followed by had + participle.

items.why: We say He admitted that… or He told me that…

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: He admitted that he had lied is a report in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“Denied that” can be followed by had + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He admitted me that…”. → Falso (We say He admitted that… or He told me that…)

pages.title: The rent that disappeared · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy afternoon in Seattle. Beth and Clara share a flat near the lake. Their roommate has been acting strangely. Rent day passed and nothing was paid. Now the truth has finally come out. The two friends sit down to talk.

“Guess what? Our roommate finally admitted that he had lied about the rent for three months.” says Beth. “Really? Last week he denied that he had taken the money, and he claimed that he had paid everything.” says Clara. “Yes, and yesterday he confessed that he had spent it on a new laptop. I was really shocked.” says Beth.
